title: Thar She Bursts: Reducing Confusion Reduces Bubbles

original_source.version_note: Pre-publication author manuscript matching title/authors and central contribution; exact final wording may differ.

central_claims: Confusion about declining fundamental asset values contributes to mispricing and bubbles; a depletable-gold-mine framing reduces confusion and mispricing.

source_manifest.title: Thar She Bursts: Reducing Confusion Reduces Bubbles
source_manifest.finding: Original central claims were recorded before follow-up grading.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. Evaluating replicability of laboratory experiments in economics — Supplement, Tables S1–S2
source_manifest.finding: The preregistered independent comparison tests whether declining fundamental values increase experimental asset-market mispricing; replication N=220, original focal N=120, p=.010. The project only retested one selected result per paper.

source_manifest.title: Archived preregistered replication protocol
source_manifest.finding: The individual replication team is Anna Dreber, Siri Isaksson and Magnus Johannesson, distinct from the original authors; this page is a protocol, not a results report.
